scope: Tile-copy EXG hardware context and the five scene blit helpers; original instructions and payload are preserved.

framework.context: Full hardware-base values survive data/address register copies and EXG; CFG joins require matching incoming base identities. Native platform-address uses feed normal source rendering.
conservative_cases: Partial writes, unknown loads, changed address registers, opaque calls and explicit pointer seeds discard prior hardware identity. Calls restore only registers proven preserved by existing summaries; CFG jump edges retain unchanged values.
The existing linear source-quality path invalidates exchanged/clobbered address contexts; new exchange facts come from the CFG result.
framework.sdk_constant_admission: Resolve registered constants in the native SDK registry before source-label admission. Names absent from the rendered declaration index are supported; mismatched values refuse before append.

limits: Zero tile width/height underflows the DBF counters; the helper has no dimension admission guard.
Synthetic widths/heights beyond the view and H=49 are accepted; bounds describe the tested packets, not arbitrary replacement safety.
Tests use an explicit custom-register shadow and do not execute pixel DMA, prove allocation/alias exclusion or establish whole-game relocation.
All helpers poll before packet use; final starts may outlive return. INTREQR BLIT polling is distinct from a full bus/DMA lifetime proof.
Masked helpers restore D4-D7 with MOVEM.W sign extension; the aligned entry clears D6 before saving.

Conservative call/write invalidation removes earlier display/audio names where the current analysis lacks a proved hardware return value or channel-base relation. Byte exactness does not close those return/base contracts; graphics/display.i is no longer selected by this projection.

existing_coverage_inventory.scope: Existing inventory partition; not rederived at this revision and not a semantic completion claim.

limits: Exact original-layout reproduction is a separate verification receipt.
Declarations and candidate/query counts do not establish semantic truth or complete ownership.
Raw preservation and the existing coverage partition do not establish resource purpose.
Alternate-layout readiness requires closed references, placement/lifetime constraints and changed-layout execution evidence.
